question: Should Twilio RCS Business Messaging ship as a bundled OpenClaw channel, or should the same Plugin SDK implementation be maintained and published as an external plugin/ClawHub package?
rationale: The code demonstrates that current plugin seams can host the integration, while bundling would add long-term core distribution, dependency, documentation, configuration, and security-support commitments that source review cannot choose on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Externalize as an RCS plugin
options.body: Move the Twilio-specific channel into an external package using the existing Plugin SDK and publish it through the normal plugin/ClawHub route after real sender/device proof.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Explicitly accept RCS as a supported core channel, approve the exact dependency graph, define the SMS collision upgrade behavior, and require carrier sender/device proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Externalize as an RCS plugin
recommendation.body: Move the Twilio-specific channel into an external package using the existing Plugin SDK and publish it through the normal plugin/ClawHub route after real sender/device proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged SMS-channel implementation is the closest bundled-channel precedent and owner boundary for this distribution decision.
